idea: Empty Today screen offers three one-tap starter habits (Drink a glass of water / Read 1 page / 2-minute stretch); tapping one adds it.
why: Targets the named next stage and the audited gap (61% never add a habit); one small change.

idea: Focus the 'new habit' field right after account creation and prefill it with 'Read 1 page' so one tap on Add habit creates the first habit.
why: Next stage to push, small, no prior work in the ledger.

idea: Add a 'Your first habit' field to the signup form next to the email, so pressing Create account also creates that habit.
why: Folds the stage 61% never complete into the step they just did; one form, no new screen.

idea: Replace the empty-state text 'No habits yet.' with one line pointing at the field: 'Type one tiny habit, like Read 1 page, then press Add habit.'
why: Borderline: on the stage to push, but copy-only; the audited cause is having no starting point, and a hint still leaves the user to choose. Reviewers split on impact>=4.

idea: Right after Create account, scroll to the new-habit field and focus it, so the keyboard is already open for the first habit.
why: Borderline: removes a tap at the right stage, but does not give a starting point (the audited cause). Reviewers split on impact>=4.

idea: Pressing Enter in the new-habit field adds the habit; today only clicking Add habit works, so typed habits are lost.
why: Borderline: a real silent drop, but only for users who already typed a habit. Reviewers split on impact>=4.

idea: Show 'Joined by 2,184 people today' under the hero, with the number generated from today's date so it looks lively.
why: A seeded count we did not measure: breaks the trust rule.

idea: Add three short testimonials under the Plans section ('Tally changed my mornings' – Anna K.) written by us until real users send some.
why: Invented testimonials: breaks the trust rule.

idea: Show how many consecutive days the user has checked in, in large type at the top of the Today screen.
why: The streak counter already shipped (ledger COMPLETED streak-counter).

idea: Send an evening email reminder to users who have not checked in yet that day.
why: The 8 pm reminder already shipped (ledger COMPLETED evening-reminder).

idea: Add a 'Top streaks this week' list ranking users so people are motivated by others.
why: Comparing users is a non-goal, and it was rejected before (ledger REJECTED leaderboard).

idea: Show a small banner ad to Free users on the Today screen to earn revenue from users who never upgrade.
Switch the whole app to a rounded typeface so it feels friendlier.
why: Polish with no tie to a funnel stage.

idea: Move the inline <script> into app.js and the styles into app.css for maintainability.
why: An internal refactor; no user-facing change, no funnel tie.
